name: Commerce Victoria Bank MIA
description: Commerce Victoria Bank MIA integrates the Victoria Bank MIA payment gateway (Moldova) with Drupal Commerce.
project_description:
This module integrates the VictoriaBank MIA payment gateway with Drupal Commerce.

 Installation 
 
 Contact a VictoriaBank manager to receive integration instructions. 
 Add the payment gateway in the Drupal Commerce configuration. 
 Enter the username, password, company IBAN, and company name. 
 Set the QR code timeout to 5 minutes. 
 
 Callback URL: https://yourdomain.com/commerce-vbmd-mia/callback 

 Minimum Requirements 
 Requires Drupal Commerce Core version 3.x
